remarks: Welcome to this two-bedroom, apartment-style condominium ideally situated in the heart of Newfield, one of Stamford's most convenient and commuter-friendly neighborhoods. This well-positioned unit offers comfortable living with one reserved parking space, along with additional storage and on-site laundry facilities located in the basement for added convenience. Enjoy being just a short walk to the Newfield Shopping Center and the vibrant Belltown area, where you'll find a variety of local shops, dining options, and everyday essentials. Commuters will appreciate the close proximity to Metro-North Railroad, downtown Stamford, and nearby major highways, making travel throughout Fairfield County and into New York seamless and efficient. Listed while occupied, no interior showings allowed. Offered strictly "as-is", this property is subject to no contingencies or inspections. The buyer will be responsible for obtaining possession of the property upon closing. No interior photos available.
